known_limitations: US-listed proxies trade during US hours (Xetra products trade during European hours); converted with the ECB rate published before the US close.
US-listed proxies pay dividends gross of the 15% US withholding that Irish UCITS funds suffer; not adjusted (no new parameter).
DJP is an ETN (issuer credit risk); used only as a history of the Bloomberg Commodity total-return index.
Spreads and slippage are constant estimates; historical spreads (e.g. 2009-2012) were likely wider.
IBKR pays no interest on the first EUR 10,000 of cash and benchmark minus 0.5 p.p. above it (secondary-source snapshot); the protocol's cash rate is EUR STR minus 0.25 p.p. for every capital.
